title: A Traditional Chinese console reads and writes the Simplified entry of an inline label map
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf

Filing gate: ① product defect, named location. Out-of-scope finding S1 of the contract review of PR #30902 (6682790803, card #30511), which makes `zh-Hant` a console language. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: a · reach: every inline locale map an author writes with both a Simplified and a Traditional key, read or edited in a `zh-Hant` console session; NOT MEASURED live (read in code on `origin/main` `98f640d581` and on the PR branch, where `pickLocalized.ts` is unchanged).

## Business reason

After #30902 a Traditional Chinese user (Taiwan, Hong Kong) gets Traditional chrome, but an object or field label written as `{ en, 'zh-CN': '客户', 'zh-TW': '客戶' }` still shows the Simplified `zh-CN` entry to them, and an edit they make in Studio lands on the `zh-CN` key, overwriting the Simplified authors' text while the `zh-TW` entry stays stale. The tenant sees mixed scripts on one screen and loses text on save.

## Where

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts` `pickLocalized`: for `language = 'zh-Hant'`, `read('zh-Hant')` and `read('zh')` miss, then the region limb takes the FIRST own key sharing the base `zh` (`zh-CN` in authoring order), never a key of the same script.
- Same file, `localeWriteKey` (the write-side twin): the same first-sibling limb picks the key an edit is written to.

## Wanted

1. Measure first on the #30902 head (or `main` after it lands): a `zh-Hant` session over a map holding `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` (and `zh-Hant` / `zh-Hans` spellings); record which entry is read and which key an edit writes.
2. If it reproduces: the read and write limbs prefer a key of the same script (the spec's `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` / `platformLocaleTagOf` already say `zh-TW` / `zh-HK` mean `zh-Hant` and `zh-CN` / `zh-SG` mean `zh-Hans`), and only then any `zh-*` sibling. One reading for both limbs, never two copies.
3. Pin both limbs with a test per spelling plus an ablation.

**Level:** client behaviour only, expected `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts`).
Serial: after PR #30902 (#30511), which adds the `zh-Hant` language.
Related: #30511, PR #30902, #29428.
